# Stage 6: unknown dynamics, costly feedback (generated by charts/06_unknown_dynamics_charts.py)

Higgs follower graph, weighted cascade p_uv = c_u / max(followees(v), 20), c = 0.726, k = 20, 50 rounds x 5 runs. Every percentage is relative to top-degree in the same world. Fixed policies (oracle, prior-greedy, top-degree) choose the same set every round.

## Dose-response: how heterogeneous must accounts be?

c_u = s * c * (c_u^W2 / c)^gamma, rescaled to W2's aggregate. gamma 0 = W1, gamma 1 = W2. CUCB only.
